grf.observed: Current main already contained canonical lossless use intent, deterministic package identity and merged ClayPackageResolution/v1. Parallel research then produced corpus-backed counterevidence showing that plain MODULE-mode use cannot safely be assumed to denote an exact module provider.
grf.generated_hypothesis: Bind ordered MODULE/WILDCARD use intent into package identity so later resolution consumes one provenance-bound semantic read instead of reparsing source; preserve fail-closed execution until name binding/linking are explicit.
grf.counter_reality: If every plain use were treated as an exact module provider, authorized forms such as use frank.entity.Frank would overclaim module identity where the current corpus also supports exported-symbol interpretation.
grf.collapse: The package-index/use-intent fusion remains useful, but v1 plain-use provider semantics are not promotable. The active correction path was deconflicted into PR #674 and then closed unmerged when safe exact-head execution could not be established.

sole_bounded_unusual_experiment_for_this.name: NESTED_PACKAGE_NAMESPACE_TWIN_PROVIDER
sole_bounded_unusual_experiment_for_this.baseline: One explicit provider for clay.pkg.util resolves deterministically.
sole_bounded_unusual_experiment_for_this.intervention: Construct overlapping parent/child package namespaces that both structurally claim clay.pkg.util and reverse provider order.
sole_bounded_unusual_experiment_for_this.observed: Both provider orders failed closed as AMBIGUOUS_MODULE_PROVIDER:clay.pkg.util.
sole_bounded_unusual_experiment_for_this.rollback: Discard the synthetic in-memory provider universe.
sole_bounded_unusual_experiment_for_this.reason: The result agrees with already-preserved provider-ambiguity/prefix-collision regressions; it is retained for this macrocycle's experiment accounting but does not justify a new canonical mechanism.
